item.title: Cargo Volume at Lagos Ports Jumps 90%
item.description: Cargo traffic at Lagos ports has surged, with the Nigerian Ports Authority (NPA) reporting that 18 vessels are scheduled to berth at Apapa and Tin Can Island Ports this week, carrying a mix of containers, bulk commodities, petroleum products, and general cargo.
